title: Mixed Event — Unfading Wishing — Episode3 Impossible Encounter

meta.Event Outline: The US trip is coming up fast, and Akito's been practicing at full throttle. He takes a well-earned break on New Year's Day, but while he's out and about, he ends up running into a certain someone...

rows.Line: New Year's Day
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Phew...
That shrine was totally packed.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I suppose that was to be expected, since it's such a famous shrine.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'm glad that we were both able to draw great blessings. It's an excellent way to start off the new year.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, true.
We're gonna need all the luck we can get.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Still, this place is also packed with people...
There might be a huge line to get into that cafe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We may want to head there early, since you mentioned that they'd be serving only a few plates of those New Year's pancakes...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We should probably head to the cafe before visiting the sporting goods store at the mall.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You sound weirdly excited about this for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you're right about not wasting time waiting in line. Let's head over there now.
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I've been meaning to ask...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Could you tell me more about these New Year's pancakes? I've been having a hard time figuring out how they managed to tie a Western dish to this holiday...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, they gave it a Japanese twist by making it look like kagami mochi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Apparently, it's a stack of three pancakes coated in white chocolate and a mandarin on top.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
White chocolate...?!
That's quite bold of them...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It is pretty strange, but a lot of people who had it last year gave good reviews.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, there. It's that cafe...
se_walk_men_001_2
se_walk_men_001_3

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yikes, there's a huge line...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I had a feeling, but this place must be just that popular.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That being said, I don't mind waiting.
We're not doing anything else other than visiting that sporting goods store, so let's get in line.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I feel kinda bad, but I agree. Let's find the end of this line...
Huh? Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, what are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That's my line.
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, Ena, call off your dogs. It's New Year's, remember?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Happy New Year, Akito, Toya!
I'm surprised to see you two here!
Grabbing a bite?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Happy New Year, Momoi.
One of their menu items caught our attention, so we came to try it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
One of their menu items...?
Are you two here to try their New Year's pancakes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, don't tell me you're also here for them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's right... More importantly, what's with the attitude? You got here after us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: When we got here doesn't matter.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Again, you two!
Quit bickering!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Look, us running into each other like this can't just be a coincidence, so let's all wait together, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, I asked Ena this a second ago, but how do you two plan on spending New Year's?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
New Year's?
Well, we're going to practice singing like usual...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
With the exception of tomorrow.
We're actually going to play competitive Hanetsuki with some friends.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Competitive Hanetsuki?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it's Hanetsuki with rules that mirror similar sports. As you can probably see from this image, they use larger paddles and shuttlecocks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Cool...! That's really cute, and this looks really fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait a second...
We could play this during our stream...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your stream?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! We're planning on playing a few New Year's games during our stream tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we had trouble coming up with ones that would be entertaining on a stream. Ena and I are actually gonna head over to the mall to see if they have anything good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then, why don't we all go together?
We were also planning to head over to the mall after checking out this cafe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? If you two are okay with it, then I'd love to have you guys there with us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Does that sound okay, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm not in love with the idea of going with Akito, but I guess it would make sense for us to go together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, I heard that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Ena. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And I really need to thank you two!
You guys are lifesavers!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I tried searching for New Year's games we could play during our stream, but I ended up with way too many choices. It was hard to pick just one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know what you mean.
You can fly kites, play Kendama...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: My sisters and I used to play Karuta a lot when we were little. I also remember crying a lot since I could never beat my big sis.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
New Year's, huh...?
We usually played that one board game about life.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I remember a certain someone always placing a big bet that invariably put them deep in debt.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, are you talking about me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I mean, you never did anything interesting.
You always ended up leading a boring life with no detours.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Stable is the word I'd use.
Which is better than being underwater in my opinion.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. Playing games with your family certainly sounds quite fun.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My family never really did any of those things, so this is all a bit new to me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
Was everyone usually busy?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, my dad usually performed in New Year's concerts overseas. We'd go as a family to watch him play.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Concerts?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Your family really is all about music, huh?

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Thank you for your patience. I can show you three to your table now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, we've been talking for so long that we're pretty close to the front now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Time sure does fly when you're having an enjoyable conversation.

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Are you our next group? I'm terribly sorry, but do you have a moment...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you referring to us?

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Yes, I regret to inform you all that...
